text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today from Aston Machan.
Make
sure to remember me, okay,
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm practicing for interviews. I expect a
whole
gaggle of reporters will approach
me after the
race.
choice_data_list: ...What are you doing facing the mirror?
...What are you doing in front of the mirror?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want to perfect every moment, from
when the
gate opens, through to the
finish line, and up
until the interviews.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Given my current condition, I think it's
worth
preparing for the best-case
scenario. Yes, I have
a feeling this
practice will come in handy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hopefully, you'll see for yourself soon.
